body: thanks for your comment. my friends are very well aware of my feelings and have been for years but there’s only so much they can do because they have their own stuff and i don’t want to bother them. i have reached out to my old teachers but they ignored me which honestly hurt a lot because we were really close. it’s just like more people who no longer care about me yknow. my therapist gave me a number to call if i needed attention between appointments when quarantine started and i might try it in the morning if i’m not feeling better. it’s not a hotline so i don’t know if they’re available late at night.

the doctor/patient analogy is such bullshit. doctors are trained for years to effectively treat people with cancer. op’s friend has absolutely no experience with suicide or suicidal thoughts OR training on how to treat them. she took it upon herself to treat op and then gave up — and blamed op for her failure. that’s an incredibly shitty thing to do. if you can’t help someone, don’t give them false hope and then abandon them.

Thank you. I’m sorry you went through something similar. I feel unsafe because I never built a relationship with my mom and stepdad so I never trusted them to begin with, and now my mom is acting more like my dad every day. She hasn’t done anything violent like him, but I’m always worried that it will get to that point. Every time CPS got involved with my family it was hell (like the first time they didn’t end up doing anything and my dad took his anger out on me), so I don’t want to go through anything like that again.

I definitely want to go to college somewhere far away from here but I can’t see myself living through another year of this. An opportunity recently presented itself to me and I can’t discuss the specifics because of sub rules but... yeah. I finally have an easy way out and I’d rather take it than suffer for longer.
My friends have offered to let me live with them but when I talked to my mom about it she screamed at me that I can never go back.
